scope: One combined build; exact regression and new OFDM/noise matrix acceptance. SD/cold start are separately required.

regression.scope: Known Phase 3 seed sets rerun on the Phase 4 eight-lane build; not new independent seeds
regression.algorithm_limit: Numerical PASS includes honestly recorded algorithm misses, false alarms and boundary failures; 0dB is exploratory
regression.amplitude_note: 4096 chosen before training to retain int16 headroom at 0dB. Historical 8192 inputs are known regression, not new independent validation.
regression.continuous_limit: Repeated 32768-pair blocks test sustained transport/compute stability; repeated blocks add no independent noise samples
